mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a labor market that is too hot and will soon lead to wage inflation, causing the Fed to raise rates and depress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows by more than 2% year-over-year, it signals a supply crunch that will hurt corporate profits and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by rising inflation.
failure_condition: Y/Y INDPRO growth slows by >2pp concurrently with rising CPIAUCSL, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and depress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales, falling more than 5% month-over-month, signals a sudden demand shock that will hurt corporate revenues and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS drops >5% M/M but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Steady payroll growth above 200,000 jobs per month for 3 consecutive months signals a healthy labor market that will support consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS grows by >200k for 3 consecutive months but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market slowdown, signaled by a 10% year-over-year drop in housing starts, will depress consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST Y/Y growth drops by >10% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid 1% increase in the federal funds rate over 3 months signals an aggressive shift to monetary tightening that will slow economic growth and depress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises by >1pp over 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.
